Samira (CS): Quick pulse on Foghorn account — noticed a 28% WoW spike in token usage and throughput but a ~12% rise in 95th percentile latency and a small error-rate bump. Anyone else seeing correlated deploys or config changes?
Ethan (Eng): Looking now. I see higher prefix cache miss rate for customer=foghorn, lots of short-lived sessions. Pulling traces and db of recent routes.
Priya (AM): FYI they flipped on multi-instance routing during onboarding last Tue to improve concurrency. I flagged it with them but they wanted the change asap.
Tara (Support): Customer says they kicked off scheduled data imports this morning which could explain the burst. I logged the import job ids and reached out for exact cadence.
OpsBot: Alert: model-serving-node-77 CPU > 85% for 2h for customer=foghorn.
Mitch (Finance): MTD spend for Foghorn is +42% vs prior month. Marking as potential renewal risk if trend continues.
Samira (CS): Action items: 1) Ethan to confirm whether caching policy / routing change is causing misses and propose mitigation, 2) Tara to validate import schedule and request they stagger if possible, 3) Priya to run a rapid cost/options review with the customer, 4) I'll schedule an enablement call. Target ETA: EOD Wed.
Ethan (Eng): Quick mitigation idea: enable a short batching window for their route and bump KV cache TTL for prefix-heavy workloads. Patch ready for canary. Example config snippet:
```
route_config:
  batch_window_ms: 50
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  prefix_kv_ttl_s: 300
```
Priya (AM): I'll ask them to move heavy imports to off-peak windows. Also suggesting a 2-week Dedicated Capacity trial so they get predictable latency while we tune.
Tara (Support): I'll attach import logs and customer confirmation to ticket CS-7845. Also capturing feedback: they want clearer docs on handling bursty ingestion patterns.
Samira (CS): For renewal risk: Mitch, if spend remains >30% above baseline we'll need to discuss committed capacity or overage credits as part of renewal.
Mitch (Finance): Got it. I'll prepare a short forecast and a couple of options (discounted commit, short pilot, or overage cap) for the enablement meeting.
Ethan (Eng): Deploying batching canary at 22:30 PT, will monitor latency + error-rate delta and report.
OpsBot: Canary deploy started by @Ethan (Eng) — canary_id=can-4421.
Priya (AM): Scheduling enablement + cost review Thu 10:00am PT. Inviting CS, Eng, Support, and Finance.
Samira (CS): Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate notes and capture feedback in CS-7845. If we see a sustained QoQ increase in token velocity, propose we move Foghorn to a dedicated pilot to stabilize unit economics and latency.
